spec_match.rationale: Separates the capability question (navigator.hid) from the platform question (userAgentData low- and high-entropy hints), which is the correct epistemology for a feature whose whole content is 'the same API now works on Android'.

interactive.rationale: The detection table reads live values and the high-entropy button makes a real getHighEntropyValues() request; verified the verdict updated to 'Linux, not a mobile form factor (Desktop)'.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises answering both questions from client hints rather than UA-string parsing, which the page does with per-row sourcing.

edge_cases.rationale: The desktop-visitor case — where nothing measured says anything about Android — is stated head-on instead of being papered over, and the capability-vs-platform confusion is the page's central warning.

conformance.rationale: The suite's platform-readable-separately-from-capability assertion is this page's thesis; 6 pass / 0 fail on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): live reads showed hid present, platform Linux, mobile false; the high-entropy request ran and the detail honestly said this desktop combination tells you nothing about the Android behaviour; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs hid/platform/mobile per read.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, captioned tables, verdict as text, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned tables with scoped headers, aria-live detail, labelled 44px button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read); on a real Android device the same page reads its own platform truthfully.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/support-for-specialized-webhid-devices-on-android/which-platform/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The page reads its actual environment (WebHID present, Linux, desktop) and — the part that earns the pass — explicitly tells the visitor that this combination is the one the feature does not address, rather than staging a fake Android result. Client-hints sourcing is shown per row and the high-entropy request runs live. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 6 pass / 0 fail. Clears the bar.
